about_the_game:
EVOLIZED: BECOME THE ULTIMATE LIFEFORM

In a universe where life is just beginning, your journey awaits on the planet Eiegôr.

Evolized is a creature-based adventure action RPG that places you at the dawn of life itself. Begin as a simple single-celled organism and evolve into a complex creature through an epic journey of survival, adaptation, and dominance.

On this untouched world, you choose the shape of your evolution. Defeat and consume other creatures to absorb their genetic material, fueling mutations that grant new powers and forms. Will you become the apex predator of Eiegôr, or will your species fade into extinction?

KEY FEATURES
🧬 EVOLUTIONARY PROGRESSION

Start as a microscopic organism and evolve into increasingly complex and powerful creatures. Your journey spans from the primordial seas to diverse landscapes throughout the stages of evolution.

🔄 THREE BIOLOGICAL KINGDOMS

Choose your path through one of three distinct biological kingdoms, each offering unique abilities and gameplay:

  • Sporen (Fungal Kingdom): Hive-minded, manipulative, and efficient

  • Feratus (Animal Kingdom): Honorable, dominant, and brutal

  • Platerian (Plant Kingdom): Wise, resilient, and powerful

🧪 DYNAMIC MUTATION SYSTEM

Consume defeated creatures to collect genetic material that fuels your mutations. Customize your creature with unique abilities and physical adaptations that change not only how you play but also how your creature looks.

🌍 DIVERSE BIOMES TO CONQUER

Explore varied environments from primordial oceans to lush forests, each with their own ecosystem of creatures. Every biome presents unique challenges that will test your evolutionary adaptations.

⚔️ STRATEGIC COMBAT

Master your creature's abilities to defeat others and absorb their genetic material. Face off against alpha creatures to gain special mutations and dominate each biome.

Evolized features a unique, stylized mid-poly aesthetic with a slightly hand-drawn look. Perfect for fans of adventure games who enjoy action and RPG elements, as well as players fascinated by biology, evolution, and creature design.

Adapt. Evolve. Dominate. Your evolutionary journey begins now.
